source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
topic: Structures for adjectival predication without buol ‘be’ (present tense)
notes: Let’s consider more complex structures. As shown above in (24a), the reduplicative element and negation suox are incompatible with each other: this fact is taken to indicate that the two are in competition to be inserted under the N/Deg functional head. (29) and (30) give derivations for N/Deg realized as Neg and Deg, respectively. Both derivations respect cyclicity and derive the right word order (in fact, they are the only ones which do).
